observed_transport_findings: The installed SDK sends the exact upload path with x-upsert:false, but a 2xx upload body is not validated against expected Id/Key, actor, version or reviewed bytes.
An interrupted upload/delete response can report an error after the synthetic transport model has applied the write. The SDK issues no automatic retry in the tested default calls.
exists() for 400/404 returns false together with an error; 403/500 throws. No result distinguishes missing bytes from caller visibility, policy or stale metadata.

info() passes through server-provided metadata without binding it to the requested actor/path/object/version. download() returns bytes with no reviewed-hash attestation or If-Match precondition in the tested default request.

remove([exactPath]) sends DELETE with a prefixes array, but accepts empty, foreign or malformed successful response bodies. That request body alone does not prove server exact-match behavior or deletion.
The tested remove request carries no object-id/version precondition. Do not invent a conditional header or assume the storage server honors one.
